concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-payto-ios-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15-captured iOS Drop-in PayTo guide for one-time and subscription mandates, bank approval, Advanced subsequent charges, and webhook outcomes.
warnings: Pending/await and bank agreement invitation are not payment authorization; AUTHORISATION can report authorized or rejected outcome.
Subsequent subscription charges require Advanced/API-only and an agreement-bound stored method; Sessions is for setup/first payment only.
Advanced action is await despite #handle-the-redirect anchor.
Illustrative requests contain missing JSON commas and curl continuations; do not present snippets as copy-ready.
RECURRING_CONTRACT recurringDetailReference and recurring.token.created storedPaymentMethodId are named separately in the guide.
